whatsNew:
Health.md 4.0 redesigns the free Mac companion to match the new iPhone app.

• A single-column Home with Liquid Glass styling, and a redesigned menu bar.
• Exports received from your iPhone now appear in Home, Activity and History.
• Pairing with an iPhone again after a disconnect works.
• A clearer How It Works guide for the bundled command-line tools.

The Mac companion stays free. Your iPhone reads Apple Health and sends the data you choose to a folder on your Mac.
